property_summary: The reference C.transfer requires a non-empty recipient array, so every successful call performs at least one external transferFrom call; the mutant replaces the guard with require(true), allowing empty _tos to succeed with zero external calls, violating the invariant that a successful transfer implies a strictly positive number of recorded callee invocations.
change_summary: Replace the require(_tos.length > 0) guard with require(true), allowing empty input arrays and changing the function's behavior for empty arrays.
